title: Personal Credit Cards: Payments Posted on the Payment Due Date
content:
On Personal Credit Cards, the automatic payment is debited on the payment due date. When the question is whether the bank failed to take that debit, the card's own payment entries on the due date are part of the answer: no payment of any kind may have reached the card's ledger with the due date as its posting date.

## Rule

The payment due date concerned is the one on the card's most recent statement. The card's payment entries dated that day are counted; the count must be zero. A payment from any source, whether a PCB account, another bank, a mailed check or cash at a branch, counts if it posted on that date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates, due date 25 May)

| Payments posted to the card | Dated on 25 May | Requirement met |
|---|---|---|
| none in May | none | yes |
| one payment on 24 May | none | yes |
| one payment on 25 May from another bank | one | no |
| one payment on 26 May | none | yes |

A payment posted on a day other than the due date, earlier or later, does not bear on this requirement.
